title: ExtlClntAppPushConfigurablePolicies - Metadata API
description: Represents an external client app’s push notification policies configuration.

externalClientApplication.description: The name of the associated external client app.

isFullContent.description: Indicates if push notifications display the full notification title and body text (true). When set to false, standard notifications display a generic message and custom notifications display only the notification title.

label.description: Label for the external client app’s push notification policies configuration.
